description: A compassionate digital platform where young Rwandan artists preserve the memory of genocide victims by recreating portraits from old photographs. This initiative offers solace and remembrance to survivors and their families while honoring the legacy of those lost. Features include a sophisticated gallery system, artist collaboration tools, and a memorial archive.
highlights: Built with TypeScript and React for type-safe, maintainable code
GraphQL API with Prisma ORM for efficient data fetching
Microservices architecture containerized with Docker
Secure authentication and role-based access control
Responsive design optimized for all devices

description: An innovative online car marketplace that seamlessly connects buyers and sellers through an intuitive, feature-rich platform. Eriprime streamlines the vehicle buying and selling experience with advanced search filters, real-time notifications, secure transactions, and comprehensive vehicle listings with detailed specifications and history.
highlights: Real-time search and filtering with optimized indexing
Secure user authentication with JWT and OAuth
Image upload and optimization for fast loading
Payment gateway integration for secure transactions
Admin dashboard for marketplace management
Mobile-responsive design with progressive enhancement

description: A high-performance, modern portfolio website built with Next.js and React. This open-source project showcases best practices in frontend development, featuring server-side rendering, optimized performance, elegant animations, and a fully customizable content management system through JSON files. Perfect for developers looking to create their own professional online presence.
highlights: Server-side rendering with Next.js for optimal SEO
Component-based architecture for reusability
JSON-based content management for easy updates
Framer Motion animations for engaging interactions
SCSS modules for scoped, maintainable styles
Lighthouse score: 95+ on all metrics
Fully responsive and accessible design

description: A comprehensive multidisciplinary healthcare platform offering nutritional interventions, personalized care plans, and supporting Non-Communicable Disease (NCD) management. Vitaway connects patients with healthcare professionals, nutritionists, and wellness experts through an integrated digital ecosystem that streamlines appointments, medical records, and treatment tracking.
highlights: Built with Laravel framework for robust backend architecture
Vue.js frontend for reactive, dynamic user interfaces
Patient management system with medical record tracking
Appointment scheduling with automated reminders
Nutrition planning and NCD management modules
HIPAA-compliant data security and privacy measures
Integration with payment systems for consultations
